title: Proteome-wide quantification of protein turnover in frog and fly embryos reveals divergent strategies of maternal inheritance: analysis code and data
description: Analysis scripts (R Markdown), rendered analysis documents, raw search outputs, intermediate files, reference tables and supplementary tables for 18O-water labeling proteomics of Xenopus laevis and Drosophila melanogaster embryos. Mass spectrometry data are deposited in PRIDE under PXD081127 and PXD084487.
